scripts.prebuild: cd ../lambda && go mod download && make build
scripts.bootstrap: bun precheck && bun --env-file=.env cdk bootstrap && bun --env-file=.env cdk bootstrap aws://$(bun --env-file=.env aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text)/us-east-1
scripts.diff: bun prebuild && bun precheck && bun --env-file=.env cdk diff
scripts.deploy: bun prebuild && bun precheck && bun --env-file=.env cdk deploy --all
scripts.local:deploy: bun prebuild && bun --env-file=.env.local cdklocal deploy --require-approval never && bun run local:postdeploy
